name: autowra
description: Autowra - on-demand car & bike wash marketplace (customer app, partner app, admin dashboard, shared API)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @autowra/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @autowra/validation && npm run build --workspace @autowra/config && npm run build --workspace @autowra/api-client
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace @autowra/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace @autowra/validation && npm run typecheck --workspace @autowra/config && npm run typecheck --workspace @autowra/api-client
